additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0393925 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Maybe
Onsite Troubleshooting
Yes
End Customer Communication
Spare Part Ordering
Maybe
Performance monitoring by RC
Please align for a site intervention to check the Fast Shutdown wiring, as the converter grouping is not initializing. We have made changes to the PLC configuration related to the power converter, as per the charger configuration, but the issue persists after reboot. We need to check the wiring on the power converter pins 7 & 8 and 11 & 12 in all power converters. Additionally, please inspect the QA32 contactor and +F03 XD6 terminals for any loose connections. Also, verify the TB18 12VDC power supply and +F03 FC23 circuit breaker, and check the +F03 XD5 terminal pins for any loose connections. Please check wiring connections to KF13 also that are connected to 4 & 5 pin of SuC and suO of the KF13.
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Shrey Sharma
